svg.aria-label: Two large numbers, as reported by one of the largest internet networks: over 10 billion AI-bot requests a week, April 2026, and more than 1,700 percent growth in AI-agent requests in a year, September 2026. Below: I believe whoever owns the decision layer on that traffic will own key internet infrastructure for the next decade. The forecast is ours, a belief, not a measurement.
